content: In Haggai, what lay in ruins while the people lived in fine houses?
explanation: They neglected God's temple. “Is it a time for you yourselves to live in your paneled houses, while this house lies in ruins?” (Haggai 1:4, BSB)

content: In Haggai, what does the LORD tell the people to consider carefully?
explanation: Their work was not blessed. “Consider carefully your ways.” (Haggai 1:5, BSB)

content: In Haggai, to whom does the silver and gold belong?
explanation: God owns everything. “The silver is Mine, and the gold is Mine, declares the LORD of Hosts.” (Haggai 2:8, BSB)

content: In Haggai, the people earned wages to put into what kind of bag?
explanation: Nothing stayed with them. “You earn wages to put into a bag pierced through.” (Haggai 1:6, BSB)

content: In Haggai, how will the latter glory of God's house compare to the former?
explanation: God promised peace there. “The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former” (Haggai 2:9, BSB)

content: In Haggai, to which governor of Judah did God's word come?
explanation: Also to Joshua the high priest. “to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah” (Haggai 1:1, BSB)

content: In Haggai, what did God say He would make Zerubbabel like?
explanation: God had chosen him. “and I will make you like My signet ring, for I have chosen you” (Haggai 2:23, BSB)

content: In which king's second year did Haggai's prophecy begin?
explanation: On the first day of the sixth month. “In the second year of the reign of Darius” (Haggai 1:1, BSB)
